storyCards.headline: Lambada: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Kaoma's "Lambada" reached #46 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Lambada", also known as "Chorando Se Foi (Lambada)" or "Llorando se fue (Lambada)" (both meaning "crying, he/she went away" in Portuguese and Spanish, respectively), is a song by French-Brazilian pop group Kaoma.

The song peaked at #46 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Lambada was released in 1990.
